home.welcomeTitle: Welcome to the official website of the NGO-ABOI
home.welcomeDesc: We are dedicated to uplifting communities through a holistic approach that bridges traditional values with modern scientific advancement. Our commitment is to foster lasting peace, empower individuals through education, and ensure sustainable health and environmental practices across Benin and beyond. Join us in building a future where every individual has the opportunity to thrive.

about.title: Building a future of solidarity, science and peace
about.subtitle: We are an institution dedicated to fostering sustainable development and mutual understanding across communities. By combining rigorous scientific approaches with unwavering humanitarian values, we construct pathways to lasting peace and shared prosperity.
about.visionText: To be the leading institution in driving systemic, positive change through applied science and compassionate action.
about.guideText: Providing strategic direction and ethical frameworks for sustainable development initiatives.
about.educateText: Empowering communities through accessible, high-quality knowledge and skills training.
about.supportText: Delivering tangible resources and institutional backing to grassroots peace-building efforts.
about.transparencyText: We operate with a commitment to clarity, ensuring our structure and impact evaluations are accessible and accountable.
about.sectorDesc: Our operations are divided into highly specialized, autonomous sectors. This modular approach allows for rapid response, specialized expertise, and precise allocation of funds to where they are needed most.
about.impactDesc: Every initiative undergoes continuous, data-driven assessment. We utilize independent audits and transparent reporting mechanisms to ensure every contribution translates into measurable, sustainable outcomes.

pillars.title: A global impact through four strategic pillars
pillars.subtitle: Our mission is structured around four interconnected areas, allowing us to respond holistically to the spiritual, social, educational, and environmental needs of our communities.

news.title: News & Live from the Field
news.subtitle: Stay updated with our latest initiatives, community impact stories, and official press releases from across our operational regions.

contact.title: Partnership & Contact
contact.subtitle: Connect with us to forge meaningful collaborations or to learn more about our initiatives. We welcome technical, financial, and waqf partnerships.
contact.technicalDesc: Share your expertise and specialized skills to enhance our project delivery and operational capacity.
contact.financialDesc: Support our missions through direct funding, grants, or regular donations to ensure sustainable impact.
contact.waqfDesc: Contribute to long-term community assets through endowment projects that provide perpetual benefits.
